summary: Beside a wide Light Cycles or Pong arena the rail was a "Game record" card holding nothing but History and stats, since a game played in real time has no moves to list, with Offer draw and Resign in a separate card far below. A real-time game now has no record card: beside its arena the rail is one Players card (each player's strip under the game's line, History and stats at its title, the commands at its foot), and on a phone History and stats sits with the play actions.
